text: 燧原科技公告，公司股票将于2026年9月11日在上海证券交易所科创板上市；截至公告披露日，公司尚未盈利，自上市之日起纳入科创成长层。本次发行后总股本为4.3亿股，上市初期无限售流通股数量为1790.03万股，占本次发行后总股本的比例为4.1595%。
text_en: Suiyuan Technology announced its shares will list on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market on September 11, 2026. As of the disclosure date, the company has yet to turn profitable and will enter the STAR Growth tier upon listing. Post-issuance total share capital is 430 million shares, with initial unrestricted floating shares of 17.9003 million, representing 4.1595% of total share capital.
